columns.name: image_id
columns.description: Unique image ID as used by the Science Data Pipeline

columns.name: night_mjd
columns.description: Truncated Modified Julian Date at the start of night

columns.name: date
columns.description: Modified Julian Date at the start of the exposure

columns.name: ra
columns.description: Right Ascension of the exposure centre taken from the telescope

columns.name: decl
columns.description: Declination of the exposure centre taken from the telescope

columns.name: field_id
columns.description: SkyMapper field ID

columns.name: exp_time
columns.description: Exposure time

columns.name: airmass
columns.description: Airmass of the exposure centre taken from the telescope

columns.name: filter
columns.description: SkyMapper photometric filter (uvgriz)

columns.name: rotator_pos
columns.description: Angular position of the instrument rotator

columns.name: object
columns.description: Survey/field/image_type identifier (not unique)

columns.name: image_type
columns.description: Image type: ms=Main Survey - fs=Shallow Survey - std=Standard Field - 3ps=Non-survey Image - bad=Bad-seeing Image

columns.name: img_qual
columns.description: Quality level of this image from 1=best to 3=worst

columns.name: fwhm_mean
columns.description: Average full width at half maximum for the exposure

columns.name: elong_mean
columns.description: Average elongation (A/B) for the exposure

columns.name: background
columns.description: Average background counts for the exposure

columns.name: zpapprox
columns.description: Approximate photometric zeropoint for the exposure (appropriate for centre of mosaic)

columns.name: zp_rms
columns.description: RMS in photometric zeropoint for the exposure

columns.name: zp_fitstars
columns.description: Number of stars in photometric zeropoint for the exposure

columns.name: zp_gradient_x
columns.description: Gradient in photometric zeropoint in x_mosaic coordinate

columns.name: zp_gradient_y
columns.description: Gradient in photometric zeropoint in y_mosaic coordinate

columns.name: wcs_fitstars
columns.description: Number of stars in WCS solution for mosaic

columns.name: wcs_rms
columns.description: RMS in WCS solution for mosaic
